sloka: तमुवाच महातेजा वैनतेयो महाबलः ।पतत्रिराजः प्रीतात्मा हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः ।। ६.५०.४५ ।।।।
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejā vainateyo mahābalaḥ ।patatrirājaḥ prītātmā harṣaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.50.45 ।।।।

translations.english: To Rama whose eyes were filled with joyful tears, Vinatha, the king of birds, full of brightness and strength said.
